title: Dozens Massacred in Haiti, Officials Say, Heightening Fears of Gangs
summary_full: Gangs targeted a key community on the outskirts of the capital, raising fears about the gangs’ next move. The mayor said at least 25 people had been killed, but the U.N. put the death toll at 47.
